These terms govern your use of the platform to accept payments from your customers. The platform acts as merchant of record for transactions processed through hosted checkout, and settles the proceeds to you after fees, refunds, chargebacks and any amounts held as a security deposit.

You agree to provide accurate information, keep it up to date, sell only goods and services permitted for your business, and cooperate with reviews required by law or by our payment partners. We may suspend processing or payouts where required to manage risk or comply with law.

The final terms will set out fees, settlement timing, liability, termination and governing law.

We collect the information in this application — about your business and the people related to it — to verify identity, assess eligibility, meet anti-money-laundering and sanctions obligations, and provide the service.
